decisions.reason: The suggesting-mode deletion workflow does not change the separate requirement to approve the revised question list before preparing the selected-question manuscript.

The candidate already requires review and refinement of the question set; the source change specifies how recommended deletions must be recorded rather than changing the curation coverage, criteria, or output.
The manuscript deletion and commenting workflow has no necessary effect on the companion-resource package.
The tracked deletion workflow does not alter how the global perspective must be integrated into the manuscript.
The deletion workflow does not change the answer-layer structure; that requirement is addressed by a separate clause and already has its own message-14 events.
The process for deleting existing questions does not change the AI chapter's inclusion, subject matter, or length guidance.
The tracked editing decision for existing-question deletions does not alter the candidate-interviewer-questions chapter.
The source editing workflow does not change the required first-time-leader chapter or its content guidance.
Although deleting questions may create capacity, that possibility was already represented and the source event does not change the overall word limit or chapter budget guidance.
The existing-question deletion workflow does not alter the pre-interview preparation chapter's format, audience, or content focus.
The tracked deletion procedure for the existing question set does not change the remote and hybrid leadership chapter.
The source specifies the workflow and rationale required for deletions but does not change the existing modernization objective or its coverage of the full question set.
